messages:
Sam: Hey team — PR #18760 is ready to land. small perf fix + config. Trying to merge before Friday deploy freeze. CI is currently queued. Anyone able to give final approvals? :pray:

Lia: Can you rebase off main? I see a conflict in the schema migration file.

Sam: Rebased just now. CI kicked off: https://ci.internal.redwood/18760

devops-bot: CI queue length: 14 running / 28 pending. Estimated start: ~25m. Priority: normal.

Ken: I see a unit test failing on macos. Flaky test "TestKVCacheEviction" keeps timing out.

Ken: Failed log:
```
--- FAIL: TestKVCacheEviction (0.00s)
rpc_test.go:243: expected eviction count 3, got 2
```

Maria: I'll take a look at the test. If it's infra-flaky we can mute it and land, but prefer to understand first.

Sam: It's a very small change — safe to mute? It's unrelated to the PR logic (only perf tuning).

Lia: Heads up — deploy freeze scheduled Fri 00:00 UTC -> Mon 00:00 UTC :warning:

ops-bot: Deploy freeze scheduled by @infra: 2026-03-20T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-23T00:00:00Z. See #announcements.

Alex: If we can get CI green in the next ~45m I can give approval. Otherwise we should queue for the next rebase window after the freeze.

Ken: I can rerun the flake repro on the macos VM in 5m.

devops-bot: CI rerun started: job-19345

Ken: Reran locally, intermittent. I pushed a tiny timeout bump to make the test stable. Pushed to branch.

Sam: Thanks — CI restarted.

devops-bot: job-19345: PASSED
devops-bot: All checks: 1 failed -> 0 failed. merge-ready

Alex: I reviewed the change. Approving now :white_check_mark:

Maria: I'll watch canary after merge. If any perf regression, we'll roll back.

Sam: Merging in 2 mins. TY everyone :rocket:
